intro.title: Build typed query key factory
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a typed query key factory in TypeScript to generate consistent, type-safe keys for data fetching. You will learn how to use TypeScript's generic types and function signatures to create a reusable utility. The core concept involves structuring keys as arrays and ensuring their types are correctly inferred. This will help you manage cache keys in applications like React Query or TanStack Query with full type safety.
intro.usecase: Typed query key factories are essential in data-intensive applications like e-commerce dashboards where developers need to manage complex filtering systems. For example, when building a product filtering panel that combines category, price range, and customer ratings, typed keys ensure each filter combination is uniquely and safely tracked. This pattern prevents cache collisions in shopping carts or inventory management systems where multiple users might be viewing different filtered product sets simultaneously. By implementing type-safe query keys, developers can confidently build features like real-time analytics dashboards or multi-tab admin panels without worrying about stale or mixed-up data.
